name: animata
title: Animata
responsibility: Animated website components — cards, hover effects, background/text effects, interactive sections. Strong decorative-animation source, especially strong on playful micro-interactions.

upstream.notice: MIT (c) codse. Snapshot = the repo's `animata/` component directory (414 TSX incl. *.stories.tsx). No registry API exists; fetch items from the snapshot or raw.githubusercontent.com/codse/animata/main/animata/<category>/<name>.tsx.

itemShape: plain TSX per component: animata/<category>/<name>.tsx + optional <name>.stories.tsx. Imports are relative within the folder; copy the component and any siblings it references.
reachFor: Interactive sections and decorative animations for landing pages
avoid: Stories files are dev-only — never vendor *.stories.tsx into presets
